root.label: FIA investigation and software-testing response to Malaysia F1 bug

events.label: FIA investigation and software-testing response to Malaysia F1 bug

slots.name: investigation findings
slots.sentence: The FIA, the governing body for F1, on Thursday said its investigation found that cars “experienced a loss of power beyond the original intent and that could not be recovered.”

slots.name: prior software tests
slots.sentence: The FIA said it had conducted testing on the software which failed last week, but that took place in two practice sessions which were largely dry ahead of races in Belgium and the Netherlands.
